---
title: smalldocs 0.1
subtitle: The first release
date: 2026-10-10
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

The first release of smalldocs builds websites from `_quarto.yml` projects: pages with a navbar, a
sidebar and a table of contents; notebooks with their saved outputs; reference pages from the code;
listings with categories and a feed; any Bootswatch theme, in light and dark. It previews with a
reload on each change, and publishes to GitHub Pages.

It was made to build the docs of a few projects without Quarto, and builds them with the same pages,
anchors and links.
